audit.why: The level chart tile and the paragraph under it currently tell a reader two different stories for every single stage.
audit.corrected: See edits — phases[N].side moved to match the already-correct win[N], with ratings adjusted down for the Swain-favored early/mid rows.

audit.why: Swain out-ranges and out-sustains through Soul Fragment healing for most of the lane, Morgana only takes over late once he's immobile and lockable — content's early/mid/late text already states this and the win rate defect (58.98% owner winrate vs 6/7 Swain-favored stages) is plausible: Swain wins lane, Morgana's kit still closes out games.

Level 2 Q+W zoning, level 6 Demonic Ascension drain tank, first item widening his poke lead, and late immobility once he can't out-sustain a landed root are already the stated spikes and match the kit's cooldowns and flags.
